defs.def: the sound or sounds produced through the mouth by a person speaking or singing 嗓音；说话声；歌唱声

ex.s: Mum voiced what we were all thinking: It was strange to see the place so empty.
ex.t: 妈妈说出了我们所有人的想法：看到这个地方如此空荡荡，感觉很奇怪。

ex.s: Voices of Mom or Dad.
ex.t: 妈妈或爸爸的声音。

ex.s: There were no quieter voices.
ex.t: 所有演讲者都很自信，坦然地被人注视着。

ex.s: The Caribbean Taino, the Australian Aboriginals, the African people of Benin and the Incas, all of whom appear in this book, can speak to us now of their past achievements most powerfully through the objects they made: a history told through things gives them back a voice.
ex.t: 加勒比地区的泰诺人、澳大利亚原住民、贝宁的非洲人和印加人——他们都出现在这本书中——如今可以通过他们制作的物件最有力地对我们讲述他们过去的成就：通过物讲述的历史让他们重获声音。

ex.s: Perhaps the first thing that springs to mind when you think of storytelling is the fantasy land that took shape in your mind while Mom or Dad told you stories about princes, castles and monsters, with a unique voice for each character.
ex.t: 想到讲故事，你脑海中浮现的第一件事，或许是爸妈用各自的嗓音为你讲王子、城堡和怪兽的故事时，你心中形成的幻想世界。

ex.s: This means. for example，that a scammer could call you from what looks to be a familiar number and talk to you using a voice that sounds exactly like your bank teller 's，ricking you into "confirming " your address，mother's name，and card number.
ex.t: 这意味着，比如说，一个骗子可以给你打电话 从一个看起来熟悉的号码 并用一个声音和你说话 听起来就像你的银行出纳的，让你"确认"你的地址，母亲的名字，和卡片号码。

defs.def: having a voice of the type mentioned 构成形容词

ex.s: With genuine warmth in her voice, Rachel said they could take Emily to a nearby cafe they knew.
ex.t: Rachel用由衷的热情语气说，他们可以把Emily带到一家他们熟悉的附近咖啡馆。

ex.s: Staring at the bookcases in my study, packed with so many great books that had remained unread, I heard a loud voice in my head — “Shame on you!
ex.t: 盯着书房里塞满了许多本一直未读的好书的书架，我脑海里响起一个响亮的声音——「你真丢人！」

ex.s: The voice of the biologists.
ex.t: 当地农民的拥护。

ex.s: ●Use your indoor voice when at the Museum.
ex.t: ●在博物馆内请使用室内音量。

ex.s: There are alternatives to constant written communication, such as leaving voice messages or having a group chat.
ex.t: 除了持续的文字交流，还有别的选择，比如留语音消息或建群聊。

ex.s: Bell then gave the telegraph a voice.
ex.t: 接着贝尔让电报有了声音。

ex.s: It was that voice in the back of my head telling me that one phrase that has stopped so many people from reaching their potential: I can’t.
ex.t: 正是我脑海中的那个声音告诉我那个阻止许多人发挥潜力的短语：我不行。

ex.s: The  23  of the room was soon broken by a quiet voice from behind the curtain.
ex.t: 房间里的23 很快被帘子后面一个平静的声音打破。

ex.s: “Good morning,” the voice said calmly, clearly  24  at me.
ex.t: "早上好，"那个声音平静而清晰地说，显然24 对着我说的。

ex.s: 37     Our building even had a tiny lift with a female voice that said, “Ouverture des portes,” in perfect French.
ex.t: 37 我们的大楼甚至有一部小小的电梯，里面有个女声用完美的法语说“开门”。

ex.s: Nielsen always felt he should be doing comedy but his good looks and distinguished voice kept him busy in dramatic roles.
ex.t: 尼尔森一直觉得自己应该演喜剧，但他英俊的外表和出众的声音让他忙于戏剧角色。

ex.s: I always read ,using different voices ,as though I were acting out the stories with my voice and they loved it !It was a special time to bond with my children and it filled them with the wonderment of books .
ex.t: 我总是用不同的声音朗读，仿佛用声音把故事演出来，他们很喜欢！那是一段与孩子建立亲密关系的特别时光，也让他们充满对书籍的惊奇。

ex.s: My little voice has made me feel really shy.
ex.t: 我内心的声音让我感到非常害羞。

ex.s: The deep, gentle voice helped calm the nervous girl.
ex.t: 那深沉而温和的声音帮助安抚了紧张的女孩。

ex.s: Before Vinnie could say yes, the President hurried on, a shade of apology in his voice.
ex.t: 温妮还没来得及答应，总统便匆匆继续说，声音里带着一丝歉意。

ex.s: Her voice was soft but confident as she pointed to the corner near the windows.
ex.t: 她用柔和但自信的声音指向窗户附近的角落。

ex.s: President Lincoln's gentle voice.
ex.t: 林肯总统温柔的声音。

ex.s: I    1   （voice）my biggest concern to my mother.
ex.t: 我1（voice）把我最大的担忧告诉了母亲。

ex.s: Voice manipulation technologies may weaken that gradually.
ex.t: 语音操纵技术可能会逐渐削弱这种信任。

ex.s: When he was writing his novels, Charles Dickens would act out the parts of the characters, He’d make faces in the mirror, and change his voice for each character.
ex.t: 查尔斯·狄更斯写小说时，会表演角色的部分，对着镜子做鬼脸，并为每个角色变换声音。

ex.s: In addition, the team set up a separate experiment that suggested that the baby birds that most closely imitated their mom’s voice were rewarded with the most food.
ex.t: 此外，研究团队还设立了一个独立的实验，表明那些模仿母亲声音最像的幼鸟得到了最多的食物。

ex.s: In her study, Martin asked participants to rate their attachment to male, female, and genderless versions of a digital voice assistant and a self-driving car known as “Miuu.” It was found that gender increased users’ feelings of attachment to these devices and their interest in purchasing them.
ex.t: 在Martin的研究中，她让参与者对一款名为“Miuu”的数字语音助手和自动驾驶汽车的有性别、女性、无性别版本评价自己的依恋程度。研究发现，性别增强了用户对这些设备的依恋感以及购买兴趣。

ex.s: I was looking at the photos on the noticeboard when I heard a voice behind me.
ex.t: 我正在看布告栏上的照片，这时听到身后传来一个声音。

ex.s: Father: (raising his voice in surprise) You can't be serious!
ex.t: 父亲: (提高他的声音惊奇) 你不能是认真的！

ex.s: "Excuse me, sir, are you Bob?" Bob heard the voice of a young man.
ex.t: “不好意思，先生，您是鲍勃吗？”鲍勃听到了一个年轻人的声音。

defs.def: the right to express your opinion and influence decisions 发言权；发表意见的权利；影响
a particular attitude, opinion or feeling that is expressed; a feeling or an opinion that you become aware of inside yourself 呼声；意见；态度；心声

ex.s: Now I go dipping almost every day, and I’ve come to long for that moment when the cold becomes a second skin and my internal voice goes silent.
ex.t: 现在我几乎每天都去泡冷水浴，并开始渴望那一刻：寒冷变成第二层皮肤，我内心的声音归于沉寂。

ex.s: But that was my voice.
ex.t: 我的直接反应是假设我在听别人的录音。

ex.s: It also has a voice control setting that enables you to stay hands-free, while its waterproof band is fully adjustable so that it is comfortable to wear.
ex.t: 它还带有语音控制设置，让你无需动手，而其防水的表带可完全调节，佩戴舒适。

defs.def: the form of a verb that shows whether the subject of a sentence performs the action (the active voice) or is affected by it (the passive voice) 主动/被动语态

ex.s: Soon you will also question whether the voice you're hearing is actually real.
ex.t: 机器人电话的问题已经变得如此严重，以至于许多人现在拒绝接听来自陌生号码的电话。

defs.def: sound produced by movement of the vocal cords used in the pronunciation of vowels and some consonants 浊音（声带震动发出的元音和某些辅音）

ex.s: Before birth, babies can tell the difference between loud sounds and voices.
ex.t: 但规模本身并不是罪过。

ex.s: They can even distinguish their mother’s voice from that of a female stranger.
ex.t: 他们甚至可以把母亲的声音与女性陌生人的声音区分开来。

defs.def: to tell people your feelings or opinions about sth 表示，表达，吐露（感情或意见）

ex.s: For example, participants said they would be less likely to buy a genderless voice assistant than versions with male or female voices.
ex.t: 例如，参与者表示，与有男性或女性声音的版本相比，他们更不太可能购买无性别语音助手。

ex.s: To voice his views on modern art.
ex.t: 为了表达他对现代艺术的看法。

ex.s: Grandfather: (stepping between Father and Son and raising his voice) Hey!
ex.t: 祖父：（拦在父亲和儿子之间，提高声音）嘿！

defs.def: to produce a sound with a movement of your vocal cords as well as your breath 发浊音；发嗓音
